unresolved_design_blockers: New deterministic nuisance envelopes are not the original unknown-unbounded-variance obligation; their source or valid confidence construction must be supplied for the final claim.
The conservative finite method has unbounded tails at representative N=100,q=.4,r=.84 and at low-audit N=100,q=.1 even with known rank; it cannot meet the original 99% finite-availability criterion.
Continuum nuisance/rank projection has a mathematical specification and no certified implementation yet.
A fixed-rho or independent-calendar restriction could support a different bounded claim; it must be explicit, not substituted for unrestricted persistence.
reason: A valid restricted confidence region and a useful information counterexample improve the proposal, but they do not justify a costly final finite-availability qualification run.
certification_screen_power: Increasing replications cannot make an inherently unbounded procedure pass 99% finite availability. At a true coverage boundary .95 a valid lower-bound certification test has low pass probability; the preserved RG1 analysis records this separate issue. Do not lower thresholds or label old draws fresh.
feasible_proposal_next_steps: Use this region as a negative-control reference under explicit bounds in a generated prototype; do not claim it qualifies the predecessor task.
Derive a sharper finite mixture/test inversion with unknown covariance nuisance and certified projection before registering a full successor.
Compare additional persistent pair audits, independent gold labels and independent calendar clusters in design scenarios; no bank data prerequisite for generated/public proposal work.
revisit_trigger: A reviewed sharper method or explicit added-information law must supply valid component inference, certified numerical projection and plausible finite availability/width in each advertised regime before registration.
